answer: An ephemeris verification protocol curbs Sybil attacks across deep-space agent swarms. Probes prove distinct orbital coordinates by executing an image-processing kernel that correlates parallax sightings of an active comet. An attacker incurs the verifiable launch and propellant cost of deploying separate physical spacecraft per identity rather than spoofing telemetry. However, ejecta of umber dust can obscure background stars, causing tracking errors and false rejections.
